Here are three practical ways to handle tonight, depending on what feels most manageable: 1. **Ask for an extension now.** Send a brief, straightforward email to your instructor saying you are falling behind and asking if a short extension is possible. Doing this early takes the immediate pressure off waiting until the last minute.
2. **Aim for "done," not perfect.** Look at the prompt or rubric and focus only on the core requirements needed to submit something functional. Cut out any extra research, polishing, or optional sections.
3. **Do one 20-minute sprint.** Pick the single smallest piece—like writing a rough outline or drafting just one section—set a timer for 20 minutes, and stop when it goes off to decide if you want to keep going or take a break. See if one of those sounds like the best starting point for you right now.
